title: LiveFrames
tagline: Usage of video frames for showing stream clips powered by Livepeer.
description: This frame incorporates the proposed standard for video frames and makes use of it. It composes with a boilerplate livepeer app with a few modifications for working with the frame. The frame allows to see the latest comments con the clip taken, to go to the page where the clip and the chat is, and to watch the video of the clip from the frame itself
how_its_made: This project uses Frog as the framework for making the frame. The app leverages a lot on Livepeer and features of it such as stream clipping. In order to be compatible with video frames, a middleware is used on Frog to add the necessary metatags, which is open sourced to allow other devs to integrate video frames seamlessly :)
